title: Nyang Phon Mita Ampun .
intro: Langkah keudeh u masa sigohlom mata uroe phon jiteubiet, sigohlom soe mantong manusia fana jijak ateueh bumoe. Saboh patong geupeugot nibak bahan-bahan nyang paleng miyueb, geubri saboh stasiun di ateueh malaikat-malaikat, dan geupeuduek lam taman suci deungon peuingat nyang jeulaih. Bah pih meunan, lam saboh watee, saboh pilehan ka geupeugot — saboh pilehan nyang akan meugema lam mandum seujarah manusia. Soe tokoh nyoe?
clues: Lon teupeujeuet deungon cara nyang hana saban ngon nyang laen — teupeugot nibak abe bumoe dan geubri jiwa nyang udeb le jaroe Pencipta.
Lon geubri ilme nyang that-that meudalam sampoe malaikat-malaikat di ateueh pih hireuen keu ilme nyan.
Banmandum langét geuyue jisujut dikeue Ulôn, dan awaknyan mandum jitundok — keucuali sidroe, nyang jitulak sabab sombong.
Lon geupeuduek lam taman suci, teumpat kenyamanan dan beukai keukai — tapi deungon saboh larangan nyang kreuh.
Lon tuwoe, lon meu-ulang, dan lon hana ta’at — dan lon rasa brat keusalahan lon deungon dalam.
Lon meugisa ubak Tuhan lon ngon tutoe haba nyang jroh, dan Gobnyan geuteurimong taubat lon, sabab Gobnyan kheueh nyang paleng meu’ah.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Saboh apui nyang rayeuk geupeujeuet seujuk dan aman .
Sidroe peunguasa nyang sombong ka rhet lam laot .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Bangsa nyan jipoh lé saboh beureutoh nyang that teuga .

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful. (2:37)
